Only 22% of remote listings show salary—so how do you know what AI skills are worth?

Our latest data from Loker Dollar reveals that 487 out of 3,928 remote listings (12%) explicitly require AI skills, yet 78% hide pay. The highest disclosed range? Jabil's Sr. Principal Product Engineer at USD 132,400–238,400 per year.

AI requirements span companies like Jabil, Sardine, Sycle LLC, Creator, HSS Careers, Censys, and Devoted Studios—even non-technical roles like Insurance Agent and Live Ops Manager mention AI.

But communication still leads at 41% of listings, ahead of AI (12%), leadership (11%), sales (9%), and project management (8%).

Ready to filter remote roles that list AI skills? Search 'AI' on Loker Dollar's job board: https://lokerdollar.com/en/jobs
